scope: Retrospective scan for sustained changes in robust dispersion of exact annual first differences across active Macro-EIA and WDI Trade series.

input_alignment.first_difference: value[t] - value[t-1] only when both exact consecutive annual observations exist
input_alignment.missing_data: no filling, interpolation, or zero substitution
input_alignment.series_identity: source namespace + dataset + native metric + source entity

detection.dispersion_estimator: maximum of Qn, scaled MAD, and IQR/1.349 on transformed exact annual changes
detection.selection: maximum absolute post/pre robust variance ratio across eligible splits with at least eight exact annual changes on each side
detection.zero_baseline: retain emergence from or collapse to zero robust variance as a distinct candidate kind
detection.candidate_thresholds: descriptive screening only; not inferential significance thresholds
detection.transform_policy: LOG_DIFFERENCE for strictly positive level/index/nominal measures; ABSOLUTE_DIFFERENCE for percentage/rate measures; metric mode is pinned from source metadata and emitted on every scan
